structured.answer: The page puts the Pasgot account with the IBI 125 index fund at the top, as "הזול": 70,000 ₪ put in over 10 years becomes about 86,045 ₪ in today's money. But I don't know Pasgot, so I won't buy until I ask my son or the bank. Leumi was the best bank, at 82,968 ₪.
